title: If You Love 'Silo,' You Should Watch This Hidden Sci-Fi Gem: 'Beacon 23'
summary:
Have you watched the hit Apple TV+ show Silo? It's about people living in a giant underground bunker after the Earth becomes too dangerous. Well, the same author, Hugh Howey, wrote another sci-fi story called Beacon 23 — and it's a hidden gem you might have missed!

Beacon 23 is about a space lighthouse. In the future, there are lighthouses in space to guide ships past dangerous dark-matter clouds. The show starts with a woman named Aster, whose ship crashes. She escapes to the nearest beacon, but instead of finding a friendly operator, she meets Halan, a soldier who seems a bit crazy. He has PTSD, which means he has scary memories from war that keep bothering him.

At first, Aster and Halan don't trust each other at all. But they have to work together to fight off pirates and other dangers. There's also a mysterious mineral that seems to make Halan's hallucinations worse. And eventually, an alien artifact appears that might be alive!

The show only lasted two seasons, from 2023 to 2024, and it wasn't a huge hit. But if you like Silo's mysteries, you might like this too. Both shows are about secrets and strange sci-fi worlds. Beacon 23 stars Lena Headey (you might know her from Game of Thrones) and Stephan James.

One critic said the show is "more interested in questions than answers," which might frustrate some people. But if you're patient, you might fall under its "plaintive spell." So if you're looking for something new to watch, give Beacon 23 a try. It's a little weird, but that's part of the fun!
why_it_matters: It shows that people who seem strange or unfriendly may just be dealing with hard memories, and working together can help them become friends.
